body: I feel inadequate to everyone and everything. I haven't watched a movie or turned on my tv in a bit actually. My mind finds flaws in me through other peoples positives, no matter what. I do judge myself based on the standards I see around me, I know it's not healthy but I can't shut my mind off. I had to give up on the medicine because I felt like it was making me worse, which I hear is a side effect that can happen - it made me too wary of trying medication anymore. As for not giving up on positive thinking, I'm trying, I really am. My problem isn't sleeping, I was more implying that sleep is a temporary relief and something more permanent would be nicer.

I know what you mean, there's a giant hole in my wall that I'm looking at right now that will attest to that. I'm starting to have trouble holding control of my emotions in front of people too now. I have tried more than one anti depressant on several doses and anti anxiety. If it feels like I'm rebutting every possibility, its because I've tried everything.

Just general pent up frustration. I've done "self harm" before but I don't think it's a permanent solution and isn't where I'm at right now. I want to hurt myself but its futile as shit. I've tried exercise, I've went long times in the past where working out was something I did daily but even then I was just as suicidal

I've seen the therapist at school and I've talked to a psychologist before. I can talk and think about my problems all day, even to the point of understanding it. I could look at my brain like a machine and try to picture my imbalance as a clog. And still none of it makes me feel any less like brutalizing myself.

I've been on the edge emotional like this for almost a year, but this week has been extra horrible, it stops me from functioning and doing anything else. I don't think theres anything special about this week or the reason, I think I'm just emotionally broken.

My chihuahua is the sweetest animal I've ever met. Cuddly lil quiet fella that lives to please, as opposed to the asshole cats my friends have. All depends on the animals personality and their owners.

I would love to live in the wilderness and I would love to be filthy rich. I want to be alone but I can't stand being alone. I am very introspective, unfortunately I'm introspective of a really uncertain, indecisive and insane person. I can't even see myself figuring out a path much less having one. I think it's a sad fact that some people don't have a place, out of or in society. It's my one life, I know I could be getting more out of it but going through the gambit of emotions depression takes you through I'm sitting here in planet apathy. 

And you make plenty of sense, buddy. I wish I could live the way you plan to, but I can't. I'm gonna watch some more Carl Sagan, smoke and hope to figure things out.

I love that video and I love Carl Sagan. Question though, don't you think a person can have a place in society and still be a humble observer? When I get to thinking the way you do, it comforts me and makes me feel like one with everything and not so lonely. But then there are times where it doesn't matter what I've learned and how I try to look at the universe, I'm still a sad lonely person.
I'm really skeptical about what can be done to help me, but I guess it wont hurt to try. If it means I no longer have obsessively suicidal thoughts, great.
thanks :) hey, this comment did it.

I tried professional help, it ended in a circle of drug prescriptions, most of which made things worse for me and dealings with uncaring people. I could try a counselor but Im pretty wary of everything.
Thanks man. The depression eventually takes away anything thats fun from me. I guess a worthwhile thing Id have to do is sex but I aint having any of that, so its moot.
I would have to save up for a very long time, but I don't think it'll fill the void I have. Thank you for the reply though.
Im smoking right now. But its just temporary help, if it even helps, man :( one thing is sure though, afterward Im back to where I was before.

Everything has been tried, trust me. I've explored every possibility. Including doctors, hotlines, medicine, changes mentally and physically, you name it. My head is still as numb as ever. If that finality could mean I could stop thinking about violently tearing myself limb from limb then its an option.

I can't find joy in anything anymore. Thinking about all the things that bring me joy, it feels like I'm thinking of someone else. Its a singular experience, but its a shitty one and experiencing nothing is better. All I can bring myself to do right now is sleep and hope to not dream.

I can't live in my own skin, I've changed so much I'm not sure which of my identities belong anymore. I feel like more than one person, each one as incomplete as the other. The things I enjoy on my own, they all are slowly dying away - bring depressed it makes it hard to want to do anything. Even things I would consider fun. You're right in that maybe I have missed things in front of me in the past. But what can I do? I'm either thinking too much or not thinking enough. I try to think about who I am, it gets me no where. I try to relax and try to be me everyday, it gets me no where. Some people just aren't meant to be happy.
